scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.docker:reset: npm run docker:down:clean && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:up
scripts.db:migrate: docker exec reis_backend_v2 npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: docker exec reis_backend_v2 npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: docker exec reis_backend_v2 npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:ci: npm run docker:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm run test:backend && npm run test:e2e; EXIT=$?; npm run docker:down:clean; exit $EXIT
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint || true && npm --prefix frontend run lint
